name: Start with a season
changes: Put both years in large time-of-year buttons, so 2027 is visible right away.
Choose one of three months and see its price before opening the dates.
Book from large cards that show both the Monday departure and Friday return.
Keep a clear place for a Hot deal and promo code, labeled here as an example.
body: Customers narrow the choices in two small steps, then see a few easy-to-read trips. Both years stay visible, and each month shows its price before they commit. The catch is an extra tap for people who already know their month.
risk: Changing the time of year must also announce the new dates to screen readers and keep keyboard focus predictable.
